title: Input and Output Devices
subject: Computer Science
description: In this activity, you will explore the devices we use to put data into a computer and to get information out of it. Tip: Walk around the desk to see each device from different angles.

observe.description: Observe how data goes into a computer, and how information comes out.

captions.text: A computer works in three stages: input, processing and output.
Input devices send data into the computer. They are how we give the computer instructions.
The keyboard lets us type letters, numbers and commands.
The mouse moves the pointer on the screen, so we can point, click and select.
A microphone turns our voice and other sounds into data the computer can store.
A webcam captures pictures and video, for example in an online class.
Inside the system unit, the CPU processes the data and turns it into information.
Output devices give that information back to us, in a form we can see, hear or hold.
The monitor shows text, pictures and video. It is soft copy output.
The printer puts information onto paper. This is called hard copy.
Speakers play sound, like music and voices.
Input goes in, processing happens inside, and output comes out. Now sort each device yourself.

explore.description: Sort the devices. Drag each one to its tray under INPUT or OUTPUT, and listen to what it does.

parts.name: Keyboard
parts.text: an input device. We press its keys to type letters, numbers and commands.

parts.name: Mouse
parts.text: an input device. It moves the pointer so we can point, click and drag.

parts.name: Microphone
parts.text: an input device. It turns sound, like our voice, into data.

parts.name: Webcam
parts.text: an input device. It captures pictures and video.

parts.name: Monitor
parts.text: an output device. It shows text, pictures and video on its screen: soft copy.

parts.name: Printer
parts.text: an output device. It prints information onto paper: hard copy.

parts.name: Speakers
parts.text: an output device. They play sound, like music and voices.

parts.name: Projector
parts.text: an output device. It shows the screen as a large picture on a wall, so a whole class can see.
